name: Interactive Photo Grid
description: Full-screen tilted 3D grid of photo cards drifting in alternating vertical columns. Hover pauses a column and reveals the title, click expands a card into a detail panel with previous and next navigation.
contents: Five columns of photo cards looping the items array
Large heading, subheading and hint overlay
Detail panel with index counter, title, year, description, back, previous and next controls
behavior: Columns scroll endlessly in alternating directions inside a perspective-tilted grid
Hovering or focusing a card pauses its column, dims the others and slides up the title bar
Clicking a card flattens the grid and expands the card beside a detail panel
Escape or the back button returns to the grid
Respects reduced motion by not starting the drift
Panel stacks under the image below 768px

props.name: subheading
props.default: Quiet studies in light, space and absence.

props.name: hint
props.default: Hover to pause a column. Click to open.

editableByProps: All photos, titles, years and descriptions
Heading, subheading, hint and button labels
Background and text colors as Tailwind classes
Grid tilt, perspective, position and width

needsCodeEdit.change: Change number of columns or rows

fixed: Root fills the viewport height. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Cards are fixed at 400x640 and scaled by JS based on container height
Grid layout is measured once on mount and not recalculated on window resize
Heading overlay uses white text with difference blend mode
